eto: I'll see you on the other side, Eto.

passive.name: Undying Flesh
passive.description: Noro attacks with the two bikaku tentacles on his back, which bite enemies from beyond normal melee range and heal him for part of the damage. When Noro dies, his body bursts into fragments that crawl back together. If the enemy does not destroy them in time, he reforms with half of his maximum health. Each revive restores less health than the last, and the penalty resets once he truly dies.

revive.condition: At least one fragment survives for 5s
revive.reset: When Noro truly dies, the next revive starts again at 50%

h1.name: Writhing Tendrils
h1.description: Noro lashes out with the two tentacles of his bikaku, damaging and slowing the first enemy hit. His next basic attack within a few seconds slams it into another target.

slam.effect: Throws the first target into the second; both take the damage again and are knocked up for 0.5s

h2.name: Severed Lunge
h2.description: Noro splits at the waist, stretching his torso to the target location while the rest of his body pulls itself back together behind him, damaging and knocking up enemies where he lands.

h3.name: Thousand Limbs
h3.description: After a brief moment, Noro's torso bursts into a rain of thin, sharp limbs that strike every enemy around him before retracting. As he reforms he heals for part of the damage dealt.

heal.champions: 30% of the damage dealt to champions
heal.otherUnits: 10% of the damage dealt to minions and monsters

h4.name: The Owl's Guardian
h4.description: Noro roots himself in place and becomes an enormous maw with four writhing tentacles. Each tentacle seeks the nearest enemy champion and seizes it, dragging and crushing it, while the rest of their thrashing damages everything nearby.

seize.targets: Nearest enemy champion not already seized, once per tentacle

thrash.targets: Minions, monsters and champions not seized

effects.rooted: Noro cannot move while the maw is active

lore:
Noro is one of the leaders of Aogiri Tree and a direct subordinate of the One-Eyed King, a towering, masked ghoul who rarely speaks a single word. Long before Aogiri, he was known as Noroi, "curse", the ghoul Yoshimura entrusted with raising his daughter Eto in secret. He watched over her as she grew into the One-Eyed Owl, and for years he stood silently at her side, following her into every battle and guarding her from the shadows. Feared by investigators for his overwhelming resilience, he was rated SS and became one of the most dangerous enemies the CCG ever faced.

Noro fights with a Bikaku kagune that emerges from his back as thick, flailing tentacles, and he barely needs to defend himself: his regenerative ability is so extreme that wounds which would kill any other ghoul simply close, and even severed parts of his body pull themselves back together. In his kakuja form, his body twists into a grotesque mass of mouths and limbs. Silent, patient and unshakably loyal, he is less a soldier than a curse that refuses to die.
